subject: Re: Deployment mode & data residency — EU/APAC availability
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Luca Rossi <luca.rossi@finbank.eu>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@finbank.eu>
Date: 2027-02-14T09:12:00Z
Subject: Follow-up: deployment mode & data residency (next steps)

Hi Luca / Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn more about FinBank's priority of keeping customer PII and transaction data strictly within the EU while also supporting APAC customers for the public-facing app. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

- Requirement: EU-only data residency for all customer data at rest and in transit; APAC traffic should be served but not store EU customer data outside EU.
- Primary question: Hosted API in an EU region vs Dedicated capacity (EU-only GPU pool) vs Private VPC/on-prem — tradeoffs we discussed were latency, operational overhead, and compliance evidence.
- Compliance asks you flagged: SOC 2 logs, data retention controls, KMS/HSM integration, and regional routing guarantees.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm whether the requirement is "EU-only for all customer data regardless of user location" vs "EU-only for EU customers but APAC customers can be routed elsewhere."
2) Share expected peak qps / tokens per second and daily token volume so we can size Dedicated capacity if needed.
3) I'll loop in our Solutions/Infrastructure and Security teams with a short doc (attached) that maps options to tradeoffs and the checklist we need for Private/VPC.

Attaching: redwood-eu-region-availability.pdf (summary of region options)

I'll follow up tomorrow with an options matrix.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: redwood-eu-region-availability.pdf (pdf stub, 2 pages)

From: Luca Rossi <luca.rossi@finbank.eu>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-15T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up: deployment mode & data residency (next steps)

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the recap — yes, that's accurate and helpful. To clarify our constraints: 

- FinBank policy is EU-only for any customer PII and transaction logs. That applies regardless of the user location. APAC users must be served by systems that do not persist EU customer data outside EU boundaries.
- Low-latency access for APAC users is desirable but not at the expense of data residency obligations. If cross-region caching is used, we need strict guarantees that no EU customer data is persisted outside EU.
- We will need a statement of region availability and a technical explanation of routing/fallback behavior for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private deployments to present to our compliance team.

On sizing: we saw ~120 QPS average with spikes to 700 QPS during market open. For tokens: avg 1.2k tokens per request, peak concurrent requests ~45. This may push latency-sensitive use cases to prefer Dedicated.

Attached our security questionnaire and a short network topology we can share.

Luca
Luca Rossi
Head of Platform Security, FinBank
---
Attachment: finbank-security-questions.xlsx (xlsx stub)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Luca Rossi <luca.rossi@finbank.eu>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@finbank.eu>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-15T14:30:00Z
Subject: Options & next steps: Hosted (EU) vs Dedicated (EU-only) vs Private VPC

Hi Luca / Priya — thanks for the sizing and for the questionnaire. Looping Marissa (Solutions) and Neha (Security) to confirm technical/controls fit. Below is an options matrix at a high level and requested artifacts we'll provide: 

Option A — Hosted API (EU region): 
- Pros: Lowest ops overhead, fast onboarding, Redwood manages region placement (we can guarantee data stays in EU region and use EU KMS).
- Cons: Our Hosted offering is multi-tenant; while we enforce strict regional residency and do not persist EU PII outside EU for this setup, some enterprise customers prefer Dedicated or VPC for contractual/controls reasons.
- Artifacts: region availability doc, routing guarantees, SOC2 excerpt, KMS integration notes.

Option B — Dedicated capacity (EU-only GPU pool): 
- Pros: Dedicated hardware in our EU region(s), single-tenant pools, better tail latency for your peaks. Predictable throughput and clearer separation for compliance.
- Cons: Minimum commit and longer lead time for capacity provisioning.
- Artifacts: capacity sizing worksheet (we can size for 700 QPS peak and provide cost estimate).

Option C — Private deployment (VPC or on-prem): 
- Pros: Maximum control — customer-managed networking, can be deployed in your EU VPC or on-prem, integrates with your KMS/HSM, full audit log ownership.
- Cons: Longer delivery and higher ops burden for FinBank. Requires legal + procurement for enterprise licensing.
- Artifacts: deployment checklist, SOW template, runbook.

Requested from your side: confirm whether you need a contractual clause specifying EU-only data residency (we have standard terms + enterprise addendum), and whether you want a POC on Hosted EU first or go straight to Dedicated/VPC. 

I've attached a short next-steps doc that maps the compliance artifacts you'll need. If you're OK, propose a 30-min follow-up Tuesday to walk through artifacts and decide on POC path.

Attachments: 20270215-finbank-next-steps.pdf

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
---

Marissa / Neha — quick internal note pulled into the same thread for traceability. FinBank requires EU-only residency for customer PII/transactions. They reported ~120 QPS avg, spikes to 700 QPS, ~45 concurrent peak. They asked for: 

- A technical note on routing guarantees for Hosted (EU) vs Dedicated vs Private (VPC/on-prem).
- Capacity sizing and cost estimate for a Dedicated EU pool sized for 700 QPS with expected token volumes.
- A deployment checklist and SOW for Private VPC if they want to go that route.

Can you confirm: 
1) Feasibility of providing a Hosted EU contractual addendum guaranteeing no cross-region persistence (we have precedents but want security signoff).
2) Estimated lead time to provision a Dedicated EU pool for 700 QPS and any minimum commitment.
3) Any blockers on delivering the artifacts (SOC2 excerpt, KMS integration guide, routing guarantee doc) by next Thurs so we can present to FinBank compliance.

Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/17984 (deal record), SOW draft for review: https://www.docusign.com/FinBank-SOW-17984

-Aditya
